description: Offsets and scales a polyphonic signal, with a sample and hold, a quantizer and a jack that fires when the output changes

params.text: Sets the voltage added to the signal, -10V to 10V
Attenuverts the voltage at the Ofs jack before it is added to the Ofs knob, -100 to 100 per cent
Sets what the signal is multiplied by, -10 to 10
Attenuverts the voltage at the Scl jack before it is added to the Scl knob, -100 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: The signal to be offset and scaled, one per channel
Modulates the added voltage, scaled by the Offset CV knob
Modulates the multiplier, scaled by the Scale CV knob
While a cable is patched here, the signal, the offset and the scale are all held at each trigger and change only on the next one, which makes the module a sample and hold
A set of pitches to quantize the output to, one per channel; they are sorted, those within one volt of the lowest are kept, and the octave is then cut into that many equal steps

outputs.text: The signal multiplied by Scl and shifted by Ofs; with nothing patched into In it carries the offset alone on one channel
Carries 10V on a channel whose output voltage differs from the sample before it, and 0V while the output holds

notes: nothing is computed at all until a cable is patched into Out
menu: Offset Then Scale — adds the offset before the multiplication in place of after it
Limit to 10V — clamps the output to -10V and 10V
Hue, Sat, V — three sliders setting the colour of the panel
Copy Color — copies the panel colour, to be pasted into another OFS
Paste Color — sets the panel colour to the one last copied
